prompt: Ariana loves hats. Her favorite top hat is an 18-inch-tall right circular cylinder with a brim that goes all the way around the opening for her head. The top surface of the hat as well as the brim are covered in solid yellow fabric, while only the lateral surface of the cylinder is covered with patterned fabric, as shown. If the cylinder has a diameter of 7.5 inches, what is the lateral surface area of the cylinder? Express your answer in terms of $\pi$.

solutions.title: Use the formula $2\pi r h$
solutions.body:
$r = 3.75$, so $2\pi r h = 2\pi(3.75)(18) = 7.5\pi \cdot 18 = 135\pi$ in².

**Answer: $135\pi$ square inches**

prompt: Ariana's favorite top hat is an 18-inch-tall right circular cylinder with a brim that goes all the way around the opening for her head. The cylinder has a diameter of 7.5 inches. The top surface of the hat as well as the brim are covered in solid yellow fabric, while only the lateral surface of the cylinder is covered with patterned fabric, as shown. If the brim on Ariana's top hat is 4.5 inches wide, what is the circumference of the outer edge of the brim? Express your answer in terms of $\pi$.

solutions.title: Outer diameter
solutions.body:
The brim adds 4.5 inches on each side, so the outer diameter is $7.5 + 2(4.5) = 16.5$ inches and the circumference is $16.5\pi$ inches.

**Answer: $16.5\pi$ inches**

solutions.title: Using the radius
solutions.body:
Outer radius $= 3.75 + 4.5 = 8.25$ in, so $C = 2\pi(8.25) = 16.5\pi$ in.

**Answer: $16.5\pi$ inches**

prompt: Ariana's favorite top hat is an 18-inch-tall right circular cylinder with a brim that goes all the way around the opening for her head. The cylinder has a diameter of 7.5 inches. The top surface of the hat as well as the brim are covered in solid yellow fabric, while only the lateral surface of the cylinder is covered with patterned fabric, as shown. The brim is 4.5 inches wide. What is the area of the top surface of the brim on Ariana's top hat? Express your answer in terms of $\pi$.

solutions.title: Big circle minus hole
solutions.body:
Outer radius $= 16.5 \div 2 = 8.25$ in; hole radius $= 7.5 \div 2 = 3.75$ in.
Area $= \pi(8.25^2 - 3.75^2) = \pi(68.0625 - 14.0625) = 54\pi$ in².

**Answer: $54\pi$ square inches**

solutions.title: Difference of squares
solutions.body:
$8.25^2 - 3.75^2 = (8.25 - 3.75)(8.25 + 3.75) = 4.5 \times 12 = 54$, so the brim's area is $54\pi$ in².

**Answer: $54\pi$ square inches**
